screening_decisions.reason: RCT comparing mobilisations vs steroids vs ice therapy vs no treatment in patients with frozen shoulder. Includes manual therapy intervention and measures pain and range of motion outcomes.
Observational cohort study on shoulder disorder incidence, not an RCT. Does not test interventions.
Educational review article based on textbooks, not a primary research study or trial.
RCT comparing physical therapy alone vs physical therapy plus arthrography with steroid in frozen shoulder patients. Measures pain (VAS) and range of motion outcomes.
Systematic review about RCT reporting practices, not a primary RCT on adhesive capsulitis treatment.
RCT testing manual therapy (deep friction massage) and exercise (capsular stretching) interventions in adhesive capsulitis.
RCT comparing two exercise programs (glenohumeral ROM vs glenohumeral + scapulothoracic exercises) in frozen shoulder. Measures pain (VAS), function (Constant score), and ROM.
RCT comparing three mobilization techniques (ERM, MRM, MWM) in frozen shoulder syndrome. Measures functional scores and shoulder kinematics.

Study comparing PNF movement patterns vs conventional exercises for frozen shoulder (peri-arthritis). Exercise intervention for adhesive capsulitis measuring ROM outcomes. Conservative inclusion pending full-text verification of randomization.
RCT comparing two mobilization techniques (AP vs PA glides) in adhesive capsulitis. Measures external rotation ROM and pain (VAS).
Cross-sectional prevalence study, not an intervention trial. Does not test manual therapy or exercise interventions.
Case report series, not an RCT or quasi-randomized trial. No control group or randomization.
RCT comparing corticosteroid injection, supervised physiotherapy, combination, and placebo in adhesive capsulitis. Measures SPADI, ROM, and function. Includes exercise intervention.
RCT comparing manual therapy and exercise vs placebo following joint distension in adhesive capsulitis. Measures pain, function, active shoulder movements, quality of life.
Observational study evaluating questionnaire responsiveness, not an intervention trial testing manual therapy or exercise.

Study comparing physical therapy, acupuncture, and combination therapy for frozen shoulder with 3 treatment groups. Measures pain, ROM, and quality of life (SF-36). Conservative inclusion pending verification of randomization method.
Systematic review, not a primary RCT.
Study comparing anterior vs posterior glide mobilization techniques for internal rotation in adhesive capsulitis. Manual therapy intervention measuring ROM outcomes.
Systematic review methodology paper about outcome reporting bias, not a primary RCT on adhesive capsulitis.
Abstract describes study on multiple sclerosis patients, not adhesive capsulitis. Wrong population.
RCT comparing corticosteroid injection, physiotherapy, and combination therapy in frozen shoulder. Measures SPADI, disability, and ROM.
RCT comparing Cyriax approach (deep friction massage and mobilization exercises) vs conventional physical therapy in adhesive capsulitis. Measures ROM and pain.
Prospective observational natural history study, not an intervention trial. No treatment comparison.
Methodological paper about meta-analysis heterogeneity measures, not a primary RCT.
Cochrane handbook chapter on reporting biases, not a primary research study.
Prospective observational study on natural history of frozen shoulder, not an RCT or intervention trial.
RCT comparing mobilization plus active exercises vs active exercises alone in adhesive capsulitis. Measures pain and ROM.
RCT comparing sodium hyaluronate injection, steroid injection, physical therapy, and control in adhesive capsulitis. Measures pain, ROM, and function (Constant score).
EMG study on muscle activity during exercises in subjects with and without shoulder pathology. Not an intervention trial for adhesive capsulitis treatment.
Study on chronic shoulder pain broadly, not specifically adhesive capsulitis. Population does not clearly meet inclusion criteria.
RCT comparing steroid injection vs physical therapy in adhesive capsulitis. Measures ROM and pain (VAS).
Cochrane handbook chapter on interpreting results, not a primary research study.
Retrospective study, not an RCT or quasi-randomized trial.
RCT comparing Mulligan vs Maitland mobilization techniques in adhesive capsulitis. Manual therapy intervention.
Cochrane handbook chapter on presenting results, not a primary research study.
Population-based observational study on consultation patterns, not an intervention trial.
RCT comparing iontophoresis, phonophoresis, and placebo in shoulder periarthritis (frozen shoulder). Measures pain (VAS). Conservative inclusion as periarthritis may refer to adhesive capsulitis.
RCT comparing local steroids, physiotherapy, and combination in painful stiff shoulder (periarthritis/frozen shoulder). Measures pain and shoulder movement.
RCT comparing electroacupuncture plus exercise, interferential electrotherapy plus exercise, and no treatment in frozen shoulder. Measures Constant Murley Assessment and VAS.
RCT comparing physical therapy plus ibuprofen vs ibuprofen alone in adhesive capsulitis. Measures SPADI and global rating.
RCT comparing end range mobilization techniques plus exercises and ultrasound vs exercises and ultrasound alone in adhesive capsulitis. Measures ROM and pain (VAS).
RCT comparing anterior vs posterior glide mobilization techniques for external rotation ROM in adhesive capsulitis. Manual therapy intervention.
RCT comparing triamcinolone injection, physiotherapy, combination, and placebo in adhesive capsulitis. Measures SDQ, pain (VAS), and ROM.
RCT comparing manipulation under anesthesia, peri-articular injection, and physiotherapy in adhesive capsulitis.
Systematic review, not a primary RCT.
Cochrane handbook chapter on meta-analysis, not a primary research study.
Despite title suggesting RCT, abstract describes prospective observational study comparing factors affecting rehabilitation outcomes, not a randomized intervention trial with treatment groups.

Prospective clinical trial (systematically allocated) comparing chiropractic manipulation with exercise vs mobilization with exercise in frozen shoulder. Measures SPADI. Conservative inclusion pending verification of randomization method.
RCT comparing high-grade vs low-grade mobilization techniques in adhesive capsulitis. Measures ROM and shoulder disability (SRQ, SDQ).
RCT pilot study comparing passive mobilization plus home-care vs home-care alone after corticosteroid injection in adhesive capsulitis. Measures pain (VAS), SPADI, and ROM.
